question: What are the individual baryon/photon/massless-UR scalar perturbations of the pinned historical RTK production trajectory at the already-frozen common superhorizon onset, and do they provide a clean read-only control for the subsequent completed-U1 O(k^2) gradient solve?
scope: read-only historical action-fluid CLASS control; no completed-U1 metric feedback and no physical seed claim
forbidden_species_interpretation: Do not treat the legacy Omega0_cdm storage alias or fitted RTK Om as physical CDM; RTK Om is Omega_khronon on model=2.
derived_controls: theta_i/k^2 and shear_ur/k^2 are exported as regularity controls, not fitted initial conditions

classification_rule.technical_pass: Exactly nine histories at the frozen k values, all requested fields finite, and interpolation covers the frozen onset.
classification_rule.control_consistent_scoped: technical pass and at k=1e-5 Mpc^-1 both epsilon_density<1e-3 and epsilon_velocity<1e-2.
classification_rule.control_deviation_scoped: technical pass but one or both conservative low-k control thresholds fail; this does not falsify the completed theory and must be diagnosed before C10.65b.
classification_rule.technical_fail: missing histories/fields, nonfinite values, or onset outside support.

acceptance_warning: The baseline ratios are controls only. C10.65b must solve the completed preferred-DAE gradient system independently and may not import the historical CLASS metric potentials as the completed solution.
non_claims: not a derivation of B0 or N2
not a completed-U1 growing-mode uniqueness theorem
